name: Default
shortDescription: Change data capture from Postgres, MySQL and MongoDB into ClickHouse or Postgres, orchestrated by Temporal, with a web UI to manage peers and mirrors.

alerts.message: The UI is protected by a single password: sign in with the generated PEERDB_PASSWORD value from the environment variables.

No object storage is bundled. ClickHouse mirrors need an S3-compatible staging bucket (AWS S3, GCS with HMAC keys or MinIO) reachable by both PeerDB and your ClickHouse server, set in the ClickHouse peer form.
